jobs.title: Backend Developer (Ruby on Rails)
jobs.description:
Please read this JD carefully before applying. 




Ruby on Rails Engineer | High Ownership




4+ years of serious, hands-on Ruby on Rails experience | Remote / Hybrid




This is a role for engineers who own outcomes, not tasks. You will be expected to take problems from unclear → solved → shipped → owned without waiting for someone to define every step.




You are expected to think, decide, execute, and take responsibility for the result. We value judgement over instructions, initiative over supervision, and impact over activity.




We care less about how many years you have written Ruby and more about what you have been trusted to own. This role is for someone who takes ownership, moves quickly, solves problems independently, and makes the people around them better.




If that sounds like the kind of environment where you do your best work, keep reading.




Note: We are a startup. The autonomy is real. So is the accountability.




This role is for you if you:

Are self-driven and highly motivated. You don't need someone constantly telling you what to do next.Take ownership from problem → solution → production → MonitoringMove fast. We prefer decisions and execution in hours or days, not weeks of meetings and approvals.Are comfortable in a flat, low-bureaucracy environment where engineers have significant autonomy.Think beyond your assigned task and understand the business and customer impact of what you're building.Are versatile and willing to work across different parts of the product when the problem requires it.Can operate without a rigid process or a long list of predefined instructions.Are responsive and dependable when the team needs you. We value people who find solutions rather than reasons why something cannot be done.Care about engineering quality but don't use "perfect" as an excuse to move slowly.Enjoy helping other engineers. You will be expected to coach teammates, review code, share knowledge, and unblock others.


What you will do

Build and maintain our Shopify-focused products using Ruby on Rails, React, Vanilla JS.Design, implement, test, deploy, and monitor production features.Investigate and solve difficult technical and customer-facing problems.Make technical decisions independently and explain your reasoning.Work across backend, APIs, databases, integrations, and infrastructure when necessary.Identify problems before they become incidents.Improve our codebase, systems, and engineering processes continuously.Help other engineers become better through mentoring, code reviews, and technical guidance.


What we're looking for

4+ years of professional Ruby on Rails experienceStrong understanding of Ruby, Rails, PostgreSQL and REST/API development.Experience building and maintaining production applications.Good understanding of software architecture and engineering fundamentals.Ability to debug complex problems independently.Strong communication and written communication.Experience working in a fast-moving product company is a strong plus.Shopify experience is a plus, but strong engineering ability matters more than Shopify experience.


Our working style

We deliberately keep the company flat and low-bureaucracy.There aren't layers of management between you and the problem. If something needs fixing, you can investigate it, propose a solution, make the decision, and get it done.We don't run a ticket factory where your job is to mechanically complete assigned tasks.You will have autonomy, but autonomy comes with accountability.We care much more about outcomes, ownership and impact than activity.


You probably won't enjoy this role if...

You need someone to tell you what to work on every morning.You prefer a predictable queue of clearly defined tickets.You frequently wait for someone else to solve blockers for you.You dislike taking responsibility when something goes wrong.You need lots of meetings, approvals and processes before making decisions.You are primarily looking for a 9-to-5 role where responsibilities end when your assigned ticket is complete.You are uncomfortable being challenged or giving and receiving direct feedback.You prefer to stay strictly within one narrow technical area.





If you are the kind of engineer who sees a problem and thinks, "I'll figure it out," we'd like to hear from you.







Bonus

If you have worked on Shopify Apps.Worked Previously in a Startup.Worked in Product based company.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer - Ruby on Rails
jobs.description:
Job Requirements:

- Strong Ruby on Rails experience, including server-rendered views with ERB in a production codebase.

- Solid React and TypeScript skills, with experience building and maintaining component-driven front-end applications.

- Comfortable working across the full front-end stack - from Rails controllers and ERB templates through to modern React components - and choosing the right tool for the job.

- Nice to have: experience working with Stimulus.js, Turbo, and Ruby View Components.

- Familiarity with A/B testing frameworks and analytics instrumentation (e.g. Amplitude, RudderStack) in a product experimentation context.

- Experience working with microservices and/or monolith architectures. The team owns a mix of standalone services and a monolith, and is actively migrating components between them, so comfort operating across both patterns is valuable.

- Experience using AI tooling in your day-to-day workflow, and curiosity about applying it more deeply.

- Demonstrated effectiveness operating in a global company, with the communication, discipline, and async judgment required to keep work moving across time zones.

- Curiosity and willingness to explore - the team owns a broad surface area of services across two marketplaces. The right person is energised by digging into systems they haven't seen before rather than deterred by it.

- Ability to work independently on features end-to-end with the team's support, from technical spike and scoping through to deployment.

- Solid testing and code quality practices, with the ability to uphold engineering standards and contribute to documentation and system health under the guidance of the Tech Lead.

- Collaborative and inclusive - engages well across disciplines, gives and receives feedback openly, pairs willingly, and takes real interest in helping less experienced engineers grow.
